title: Our Planet Needs Help
text:
Many people in our city want to protect the environment. Every day, they walk or ride bikes to school and work. This helps to reduce pollution in the air. Some families also recycle plastic bottles and paper at home.

The city council is also helping. It has planted two hundred new trees in the park this year. Children learn about nature at school and visit the forest every month. Small actions can make a big difference for the planet.

questions.text: How do many people go to school and work?
options: They take the train every day.

questions.text: How many new trees did the city council plant this year?
What can we infer about the families who recycle bottles?
options: They do not like the park.
They want to buy more plastic.
They work for the city council.

questions.text: What is the main idea of the second paragraph?
options: Only big companies can save the planet.
Small actions by everyone can help the planet.
The forest is closed every month.

to use old materials again to make new things

plants, animals and the natural world

paragraph_translations: Muitas pessoas na nossa cidade querem proteger o meio ambiente. Todos os dias, elas caminham ou andam de bicicleta para a escola e o trabalho. Isso ajuda a reduzir a poluição do ar. Algumas famílias também reciclam garrafas plásticas e papel em casa.

A prefeitura também está ajudando. Ela plantou duzentas árvores novas no parque este ano. As crianças aprendem sobre a natureza na escola e visitam a floresta todo mês. Pequenas ações podem fazer uma grande diferença para o planeta.
